StackPanel.TextBlock:
You have carried Europe from a patrol off Alboran all the way to Russian soil. You survived the Tyrrhenian incident, defended Augusta from the assault meant to break the coalition, and struck Moscow's base on the Libyan coast. Today five flags sail under your command - and behind it all, unmasked at last: Russia.
Only one last mission remains. The Russian fleet is falling back to the west, toward the Pillars of Hercules, and the whole Mediterranean will be decided there. And in your safe lies the only proof that Europe never fired that torpedo: when the moment comes, you will have to decide what to do with it.
The final mission is coming soon. Thank you for playing Mare Nostrum '28, Commander.
